title: Response has aliased constructor pairs that add indirection without invariants
description: response.rs has constructor pairs where one delegates to the other with no transformation: service_available_posting_allowed()->service_available_posting(), service_available_posting_prohibited()->service_available_no_posting(), no_group_selected()->no_newsgroup_selected(). Two names per concept; maintainers must read both to confirm they are identical. Fix: delete the redundant aliases, update two call sites in dispatch.rs.
